# AstroFree

> AstroFree is a free AI-powered tarot reading and Mulank numerology platform. It offers instant AI-guided tarot readings across 8 spreads (including the Celtic Cross), a daily tarot card ritual, a private journal, and a free numerology calculator for Mulank (root) number, Personal Year, and Personal Month forecasts — all with no signup required and support for 13 Indian languages.

AstroFree is built for people seeking personal insight, spiritual reflection, and lightweight decision support through tarot and numerology. All core features are free: no paywall, no credit card, no account required.

## Core Product

- [Home](https://astrofree.vercel.app/): Overview of AstroFree's tarot and numerology features.
- [Start a Reading](https://astrofree.vercel.app/reading): Draw a card, choose a spread, and get an AI-guided tarot interpretation.
- [Mulank Numerology Calculator](https://astrofree.vercel.app/numerology/mulank): Free calculator for Mulank (root) number, Personal Year, and Personal Month forecasts.

## Tarot Guides

- [All 78 Tarot Cards](https://astrofree.vercel.app/tarot): Directory of every tarot card with meanings.
- [Tarot Card Meanings Guide](https://astrofree.vercel.app/guide/tarot-card-meanings): Explanations of upright and reversed meanings across the deck.
- [Tarot Spreads Explained](https://astrofree.vercel.app/guide/tarot-spreads): How to read single-card, three-card, Celtic Cross, and other spreads.

## Numerology Guides

- [Numerology Guide](https://astrofree.vercel.app/guide/numerology): How Mulank, Personal Year, and Personal Month numbers are calculated and interpreted.
- [Numerology Number Directory](https://astrofree.vercel.app/numerology): Meanings for each Mulank/Life Path number.
